src: const sk1 = sketch('top'); sk1.circle(40); const cyl = extrude(sk1, 30); const a = sketch('top'); a.polygon([[18,5],[20,5],[20,10],[18,10]]); const g1 = groove(a, cyl, 90); const b = sketch('top'); b.polygon([[17,8],[19,8],[19,13],[17,13]]); groove(b, g1, 90);

brep.refused: groove groove2: groove1 already has a round wall with a notch cut out of it by a part turn of a groove, and brep-rs can only move or copy a part like that yet -- groove2 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): a part turn of a ring that reaches the curved outside of a round part, or of a part with several round surfaces, takes a minute or more to cut here, so it is not built; turn the ring a full 360 degrees on the part's own axis, or keep it clear of the round outside wall.
groove2 (groove): groove1 was not built, so this groove has no finished part to cut; fix groove1 first.
